title: 第9章 倒打一耙赔钱第10章 守鱼
content_zh:
;;
“你.....你这是强词夺理！”
李老太爷不是李宏财的对手，被他三两句话气得脸皮涨红。
侧过身子不想看他，怒道：
“这事具体是怎么样，大伙儿心里都有杆秤，我不和你费口舌之争。”
“你家侄媳妇把泡了尿的石头往人家饭桌上砸，这大家都看见了，你抵赖不了吧！”
李宏财很具压迫性的目光一扫众乡亲，压得他们抬不起头。
随后视线落到一旁的王彩凤身上，笑着道：“彩凤，是你拿石头砸得人家饭桌吗？”
王彩凤这事是在众目睽睽之下撒泼胡闹干的，扯不了谎。
只能小声承认。
“是。”
李宏财继续笑笑，眼神中流露出一道颇具深意的神色：
“那石子上的尿，也是你泡的吗？”
王彩凤抬头身形一抖，飞速心领神会堂叔话中的用意，大声道：
“没有！我没泡过！我才不会去干这么恶心的事！”
李宏财得意的转身看向李老太爷：“您老听见了，王彩凤说她没泡过。”
人不要脸，天下无敌。
李老太爷被他们叔侄媳妇凭空颠倒黑白的默契做法气得浑身发抖。
双手激动的敲击拐杖道：
“人家杀鸡吃鱼正吃得好好的，石子是她扔的，石子上的尿不是她泡的，还能是谁？”

“难不成是人向东自己往上撒尿，冤枉你们不成。”
李宏财哼哼一笑，若有所思的摸着下巴转身朝着众村干部道：
“老太爷的话倒是提醒了我，这也不是没这种可能，你们说对吧。”
七八个村干部都跟他是穿一条裤子的人，纷纷出声附和。
“对对对，撒泡尿而已，又不是做炸弹，不管男人女人脱下裤子就能撒。”
“我看这事，还得开会好好研究。”
“如果真是二狗媳妇干的，这屋子砸了不冤。”
“但如果二狗媳妇是被冤枉的，这可就是借机栽赃报复，性质可就完全不一样了啊。”
这群村干部七嘴八舌说的话看似公平，两边都有照顾，但实则都是在偏袒王彩凤。
“你.....你们！真无耻！”
李老太爷被他们气得够呛，双手拄着拐杖身形摇摇欲坠。
李向东眼疾手快，一个箭步冲到他身边扶住。
伸手拍起他后背，直到那口气顺下去才松开手笑着道：
“老太爷，别生气，气坏了不值得。”
眼见他们联起手来颠倒乾坤，行动不便的李月红急匆匆跑出来哭喊。
“事情不是这样的，你们胡说！”
李向东刚安抚好老太爷，看到母亲激动的跑出来，担心她因为情绪过度而导致病情加重。
急忙上前扶住她小声安慰。
“妈，妈，你也别担心，这里有我呢，别气坏身子。”
李向东好说歹说把母亲劝回去，这才返身走到李宏财身边。

“叔，你还真不愧是当村长的料，铁板钉钉的事都能用三寸不烂之舌反转。”
“难怪二狗媳妇那么中意你！”

"You...you are using strong words to make sense!"
Old Mrs. Li was no match for Li Hongcai, and his face turned red with anger at his few words.
She turned sideways, not wanting to look at him, and said angrily:
"Everyone knows the details of this matter, so I won't argue with you."
"Your niece-in-law threw a stone soaked in urine on someone else's dining table. Everyone saw it. You can't deny it, right?"
Li Hongcai's oppressive gaze swept over the villagers, making them unable to lift their heads.
Then his eyes fell on Wang Caifeng, who was standing aside, and said with a smile: "Cai Feng, was it you who hit someone's dining table with a rock?"
Wang Caifeng did this in public, so she couldn't lie.
I could only admit it quietly.
"Yes."
Li Hongcai continued to smile, with a profound look in his eyes:
"Did you also soak the urine on the stones?"
Wang Caifeng raised her head and trembled. She quickly understood the meaning behind Uncle Shen Huitang's words and said loudly:
"No! I've never had sex! I wouldn't do such a disgusting thing!"
Li Hongcai turned around and looked at Mr. Li proudly: "You have always heard that Wang Caifeng said that she has never had sex."
If a person is shameless, he is invincible.
Mr. Li was so angry that he was trembling with anger at the tacit agreement between his uncle, nephew and daughter-in-law to confuse right and wrong out of thin air.
He tapped the cane with both hands excitedly and said:
"She was eating well while killing chickens and eating fish. She threw the stones. She didn't soak the urine on the stones. Who else could it be?"
"Could it be that Xiangdong peed on his own? I'm wronging you."
Li Hongcai smiled, touched his chin thoughtfully, turned towards the village cadres and said:
"The old man's words reminded me that this is not impossible. You are right."
Seven or eight village cadres all wore the same pants as him, and they all agreed.
"Yes, yes, it's just for peeing. It's not a bomb. It doesn't matter if it's a man or a woman, you can just take off your pants."
"I think we still need to hold a meeting to study this matter."
"If it was really Ergou's wife who did it, it would be unfair if this house was destroyed."
"But if Ergou's wife is wrongly accused, this is an opportunity to frame her for revenge, but the nature is completely different."
What these village cadres said all at once seemed fair and took care of both sides, but in fact they were all favoring Wang Caifeng.
"You...you guys! How shameless!"
Mrs. Li was so angry with them that he was leaning on crutches with both hands and his body was crumbling.
Li Xiangdong had quick eyes and quick hands, and rushed to his side to support him.
She reached out and patted his back. She didn't let go until the tone went down and said with a smile:
"Old man, don't be angry. It's not worth getting angry."
Seeing them joining forces to turn things upside down, Li Yuehong, who was unable to move, hurried out and cried.
"That's not what happened, you're talking nonsense!"
Li Xiangdong had just comforted the old man when he saw his mother running out excitedly, worried that her condition would worsen due to her excessive emotions.
He hurriedly stepped forward to support her and whispered comfort.
"Mom, Mom, don't worry, I'm here, don't get so angry."
Li Xiangdong persuaded his mother to go back, and then turned around and walked to Li Hongcai.
"Uncle, you are truly worthy of being the village chief. You can turn around any ironclad issue with your sharp tongue."
"No wonder Ergou's wife likes you so much!"
